title: dnd-5e-2024 map stats (docs/rulesets.md#maps)
description: A placeholder map: its zones and the parent zone it details. Its diagram is at the derived path assets/images/dnd-5e-2024/map/<id>.svg, never stored. Cross-field and cross-entry rules are checks in maps.ts (docs/rulesets.md#consistency-checks); the diagram's are the validator's (docs/content-model.md#map-diagrams).

scale.description: A label for organizing the hierarchy of maps, from one room to the world. It isn't a type, and a child map's scale needn't be smaller than its parent's.

zones.description: The map's anchors, in the order its page lists them. Each has one element with id="zone-<id>" in the diagram.

id.description: A slug, unique within the map: "great-hall".

name.description: The zone's name, as its page and links show it: "Great Hall".

note.description: What the zone is, in a sentence or two.

within.description: For a child map, the zone of its parent map that it details. A map is within at most one parent, and never within itself, directly or through others.
